tip: 表灰泥时通常不可数；英式英语中a plaster是创可贴。

sourceRows.zh: n.灰泥 硬膏 熟石膏 膏药 v.涂以灰泥 敷以膏药 使...平

senses.zh: adj.可塑料的 可塑的 体态好的 n.塑料 (外科)整形的 信用卡

ex.en: Last year, the UK government set out plans to ban single-use plastic from its estate.
Americans spend billions of dollars each year trying to change our weight with diets, gym memberships and plastic surgery.

tip: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

sourceRows.zh: adj.可塑料的 可塑的 体态好的 n.塑料 (外科)整形的 信用卡

senses.zh: n.板 片 盘 碟 金属板 板块 vt.镀金 电镀 为...制印版给...装钢板 用金属板固定

ex.en: Plant-based meats are coming soon to a dinner table near you, but do they deserve a spot on your plate?
Even simple visual cues, like plate size and lighting, have been shown to affect portion size and consumption.

col: a plate of rice｜一盘米饭
tip: plate通常指浅盘，bowl指较深的碗。

sourceRows.zh: n.板 片 盘 碟 金属板 板块 vt.镀金 电镀 为...制印版给...装钢板 用金属板固定

senses.zh: n.平台 站台 讲台 月台 坛 计划

ex.en: The platform currently offers professor-led lectures on a broad range of topics, from data science to fashion design.
The State Department will announce a partnership with an online education platform called Coursera.

col: a platform for debate｜辩论的平台
tip: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。

sourceRows.zh: n.平台 站台 讲台 月台 坛 计划

senses.zh: vi.玩 游戏 演奏 进行比赛 播放 捉弄 假装 n.游戏 游玩 剧本 比赛 比赛中的动作 影响

ex.en: A test can look at many genes at once, but it's difficult to predict how they will play together.
For the youngest learners, it means they are more likely to get exposed to different varieties of play and communication.

col: play a role in｜在…中发挥作用
put on a play｜上演一部戏剧
tip: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

sourceRows.zh: vi.玩 游戏 演奏 进行比赛 播放 捉弄 假装 n.游戏 游玩 剧本 比赛 比赛中的动作 影响

senses.zh: n.游戏的人 比赛者 演奏者 演员 播放器

ex.en: If you want to build a new spaceship, the raw material has to be mined by another player.
Besides, I could teach him some of the basics from my time as a badminton player.

col: team player｜善于团队合作的人
tip: 乐器演奏者可用“乐器名＋player”，如piano player。

sourceRows.zh: n.游戏的人 比赛者 演奏者 演员 播放器

senses.zh: n.操场 运动场

ex.en: A study in Sweden indicated that kindergarten children who could play in a natural environment had less illness and greater physical ability than children used only to a normal playground.

tip: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。

sourceRows.zh: n.操场 运动场

senses.zh: adj.令人愉快的 舒适的 vi.满意 喜欢 vt.使高兴

ex.en: Or they post a photograph on Instagram, have a pleasant conversation with friends and then delete it so that no traces remain.
Losing your balance and falling isn't pleasant.

tip: pleasant形容事物令人愉快；pleased形容人感到高兴。

sourceRows.zh: adj.令人愉快的 舒适的 vi.满意 喜欢 vt.使高兴

senses.zh: vt.取悦 使高兴 合心意 请vi.取悦 满意adv.请

ex.en: If it's true that you can't please all people all of the time, wouldn't it make sense to stop trying?
Well, I could come and go as I please, as long as I was getting the work done.

tip: please是动词；感到满意用be pleased。

sourceRows.zh: vt.取悦 使高兴 合心意 请vi.取悦 满意adv.请

senses.zh: n.愉快 快乐 乐事 vt.使高兴 vi.享受快乐 高兴

ex.en: For them, it may even be a pleasure.
"This was the highest and most desirable form of pleasure and happiness for the ancient Epicureans," Soupios says.

col: take pleasure in｜从……中获得乐趣
tip: 快乐通常不可数；一件乐事可说a pleasure。

sourceRows.zh: n.愉快 快乐 乐事 vt.使高兴 vi.享受快乐 高兴

senses.zh: adj.丰富的 富裕的 多的

ex.en: Carême's cooking displays became the symbol of fine French dining; they were plentiful, beautiful and imposing.

tip: 表示物资或机会充足，不表示一个人富有。

sourceRows.zh: adj.丰富的 富裕的 多的

senses.zh: n.丰富 充足 大量 繁荣 adj.充足的 adv.非常

ex.en: There are already plenty of gamers out there who know that their hobby has made them who they are.
The students helped to make decisions and there were plenty of discussions—they changed the product's name, for example.

col: a time of plenty｜富足的时期
tip: plenty of后接复数可数名词或不可数名词，无须加a。

sourceRows.zh: n.丰富 充足 大量 繁荣 adj.充足的 adv.非常

senses.zh: n.小块土地 阴谋 情节 图 vt.密谋 绘图 计划 标示位置

ex.en: The plot of each superhero film has become relatively predictable.
But if you forget the plot of the movie or don't remember even seeing it, that's far more concerning, Daffner says.

col: a plot of land｜一小块土地
a garden plot｜一小块菜园地
plot against someone｜密谋对付某人
tip: plot指情节；作动词还可表示标绘数据。

sourceRows.zh: n.小块土地 阴谋 情节 图 vt.密谋 绘图 计划 标示位置

senses.zh: n.犁 耕地 vt. & vi.犁 耕 用犁耕田 耕犁

ex.en: Instead, it says, thanks to slowing population growth, land currently ploughed up for crops might be able to revert(回返) to forest or wilderness.

col: plough through｜费力地完成或穿过
tip: 美式拼作plow；两种拼写都读/plaʊ/。

sourceRows.zh: n.犁 耕地 vt. & vi.犁 耕 用犁耕田 耕犁

senses.zh: vt.采 摘 拉下 猛拉 拔 n.拉 猛拉 勇气 动物内脏

tip: 画面联想：复用「pick」的相关场景；请以本词释义为准。

sourceRows.zh: vt.采 摘 拉下 猛拉 拔 n.拉 猛拉 勇气 动物内脏
